title: UTMB 2026 — Race Profile / Map / Table (2026-11-07 recheck: 173.6 km / +9,700 m / 17 service points)
claims: The official interactive track view is the public source for the 2026 UTMB profile, map and timing table.
The profile covers the full 2026 course from Chamonix back to Chamonix.

The page is a standalone single-page app, not an iframe. On 2026-11-07 it rendered 17 service-point rows covering 173.6 km with +9,700 m / -9,699 m, and did not show the 32-point timing table or Col des Pyramides Calcaires cited elsewhere on this page.
